svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut eighteen 45 mm lengths of 25 x 3 strip.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bend each along its length into an L: a 15 mm foot and a 10 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: upstand (inside sizes). A vice and a hammer will do.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 5.5 mm holes in the foot, 10 mm from each end, countersunk

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the outside for M5 countersunk screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the foot lies flat across the 45 mm rim, upstand outward at the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: trailing edge, spaced every 20 degrees (about 49 mm round the rim).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the rim through the lug, drill 5.5 mm, fit the screws with the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: nuts inside the rim and threadlocker. Round the upstand corners.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lug tips sit on a 300 mm circle: this sets the spacing (942.5 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: measure across opposite lug tips: 300 mm, within 2 mm.
